source: Built SPA with intercepted API fixture; no external requests
checks: ArrowDown/ArrowUp wrap the displayed destination matches; Escape closes suggestions with focus retained; no dangling active descendant
360/390/430/1280px and 640 CSS-pixel reflow, 16px inputs and >=44px height
Destination suggestion pick focuses its summary; Tab continues to Save this destination
From editor opens by Enter; Current location plus recent place are navigable; Enter picks recent origin
Typed From ArrowUp/Enter picks the final match; summary focus continues by Tab to Swap
Trip/Map/Issues keyboard navigation retains button focus and planned endpoints; draft survives reload
Pending, empty, failed and recovered geocode responses keep suggestion state consistent
Mobile tap commits a suggestion and closes the list without reopening the keyboard
Selecting a result after focus moved to navigation does not steal focus
Current location row remains keyboard selectable with focus on the From summary
Escape from the idle From list restores the original start
Leaving a typed origin still resolves its single match; completion preserves focus on the destination
